(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Amentum is seeking systems engineering professionals to support Navy and Marine Corps systems and software development. The Infrastructure Engineer will provide software infrastructure support, perform trade studies for infrastructure improvements, and use MBSE and IBM DOORS to catalog information in an Agile environment.
Software infrastructure engineer supporting Navy projects through trade studies and MBSE/requirements cataloging

Responsibilities:
• Provide Software and Software Infrastructure support to Navy Projects in an Agile environment
• Perform trade studies to identify direction on infrastructure improvements
• Leverage MBSE and IBM DOORS for the cataloging of information

Requirements:
• 0 to 3 years of experience with C, C++, and/or Assembly
• Must have an Active Secret US Government Clearance
• Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain Secret Clearance

Preferred:
• Embedded Systems Development
• OS skills
• MBSE (Model Based Systems Engineering) and modeling
• DOORS (Dynamic Object Oriented Requirements System)
• Docker
• Trade Studies
